description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect high-performing B2B sales professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top sales talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Job Summary

We’re looking for a skilled CMS Developer with strong Shopify experience to join a growing team and build, maintain, and optimize high-performing eCommerce websites.

This is an ideal opportunity for a developer who is confident working within the Shopify ecosystem and can turn designs and business requirements into responsive, polished, and conversion-focused online experiences.

You’ll work across Shopify theme development, CMS management, integrations, performance optimization, and ongoing website improvements while collaborating with designers, marketers, and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop, customize, and maintain Shopify websites and storefronts
  • Build and modify custom Shopify themes using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Translate Figma or other design files into responsive, pixel-accurate web pages
  • Create and customize Shopify sections, templates, blocks, and reusable components
  • Configure products, collections, navigation, metafields, and other Shopify CMS content
  • Install, configure, and troubleshoot Shopify apps and third-party integrations
  • Improve website speed, mobile responsiveness, accessibility, and overall performance
  • Identify and resolve front-end, theme, and CMS-related bugs
  • Implement landing pages and website updates for marketing and eCommerce campaigns
  • Ensure websites follow SEO and technical best practices
  • Test changes across browsers, devices, and screen sizes before deployment
  • Collaborate with designers, marketers, and internal stakeholders to deliver website improvements
  • Maintain clean, scalable, and well-documented code
  • Proven professional experience as a Shopify Developer, CMS Developer, Front-End Developer, or eCommerce Developer
  • Strong hands-on experience with Shopify and Shopify theme development
  • Proficiency in Shopify Liquid
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
  • Experience building responsive and mobile-first websites
  • Ability to customize existing Shopify themes beyond basic page-builder functionality
  • Experience working with Shopify apps, APIs, and third-party integrations
  • Understanding of website performance optimization and technical SEO
  • Experience translating designs from Figma into functional web pages
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, accurate implementations
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and manage multiple priorities

Nice to Have
  • Experience with Shopify Plus
  • Knowledge of Shopify Functions, Storefront API, or custom app integrations
  • Experience with Git and version control
  • Familiarity with CRO and eCommerce conversion best practices
  • Experience working with international eCommerce brands or digital agencies
  • Familiarity with other CMS platforms such as WordPress or Webflow

💰 Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

🌎 Fully remote opportunity with an international company.

💻 Work on meaningful WordPress development projects with real ownership and impact.

🚀 Join a collaborative, high-performing team with opportunities to grow your technical expertise.

📈 Long-term career growth and professional development opportunities.
